name: Domain-Specific Non-Linear Constraint Obfuscation
description: Replaces the explicit inequality constraint (|e_u - e_v| >= 1) with an equivalent non-linear arithmetic property (product is not a perfect square) over the specific domain {1, 2, 3}. This prevents the model from immediately pattern-matching the problem to graph coloring, which in turn prevents it from applying graph-specific optimization heuristics like degree-based variable ordering, causing naive backtracking to TLE.
